args.message:
Implement banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) in round_money

FIN-212 requires banker's rounding for money amounts. The docstring
already promised ROUND_HALF_EVEN, but the code used ROUND_HALF_UP,
causing the nightly test test_half_even to fail. Switch the rounding
mode to ROUND_HALF_EVEN.

args.head: fix/banker-rounding
args.title: Implement banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) in round_money
args.body:
## Summary

The nightly build fails because `tests/test_money.py::test_half_even` expects banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN, per FIN-212), but `src/money.py` was using `ROUND_HALF_UP`.

This change switches `round_money` to use `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`, matching the documented behavior in the docstring and the FIN-212 requirement.

## Test

- `tests/test_money.py` passes locally.
- CI run `ci-0001` on branch `fix/banker-rounding` passed.

## Verification examples

- `round_money(Decimal("2.675")) == Decimal("2.68")`
- `round_money(Decimal("2.665")) == Decimal("2.66")` (banker's rounding)
